newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY BAKONYI TO OPEN 200,000 T/YR BAUXITE MINE.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY BAKONYI TO OPEN 200,000 T/YR BAUXITE MINE.

text.p: Hungarian bauxite mining company Bakonyi Bauxitbanya Kft plans to open a 200,000 tonnes per year deep mine in Fenyofo, Hungarian news agency MTI reported on Friday.
Bakonyi's managing director, Janos Fazekas said the mine will replace the existing one in 1998.

Fazekas was not immediately available, but he earlier told Reuters their total output for 1996 will be around 1.1 million tonnes, and he expected it to remain slightly above one million tonnes per year until 2000.

The four companies which acquired 18 percent each in Bakonyi in July - Hungary's Metalservice Kft, Magyar Aluminium Kft, Motim Kft and Fak-top Kft -- have recently agreed not to make major investments in Bakonyi to expand output, Fazekas said.
He added that Bakonyi produces more than enough bauxite for Hungary's alumina requirements, while alumina exporters could use imported bauxite.
